contracts.guards: Complete source roots, including list starts, heading ranks and all typed text content; guards checked before no-op detection
contracts.admission: Exact sealed flat-list compiler capability, matching process-local document proof, source/replacement fragment validation and full-result limits
contracts.inverse: Swap expected and replacement roots at the same root index
contracts.selection: Preserve text-block prefix identity, exact text-leaf or child-boundary representation, UTF-16 offsets, direction, affinity and pending formats
contracts.structuralPoints: Root/list/item interior boundaries map to the same flattened gap's affinity-owned text-block boundary; removed wrapper provenance is not promised to round-trip
contracts.atomicity: A stale later operation or over-budget final result publishes nothing and preserves redo
contracts.wire: No new wire tag; Operation V1-V5 reject list reframing, and Session V5 rejects history containing it
